hook.en: Every year from about November, families on Malaysia's east coast prepare for floods while fishermen bring their boats ashore. The Northeast Monsoon is arriving.
hook.bm: Setiap tahun mulai kira-kira November, keluarga di pantai timur Malaysia bersedia menghadapi banjir dan nelayan menaikkan bot ke darat. Monsun Timur Laut sedang tiba.

bigIdeas.en: Weather is day-to-day conditions; climate is the average over many years.
bigIdeas.bm: Cuaca ialah keadaan harian; iklim ialah purata dalam tempoh bertahun-tahun.

bigIdeas.en: Malaysia has an equatorial climate: hot, humid and wet all year.
bigIdeas.bm: Malaysia mempunyai iklim khatulistiwa: panas, lembap dan basah sepanjang tahun.

bigIdeas.en: Monsoon winds (Southwest: about May–Sept; Northeast: about Nov–Mar) bring seasonal changes in rainfall.
bigIdeas.bm: Angin monsun (Barat Daya: kira-kira Mei–Sept; Timur Laut: kira-kira Nov–Mac) membawa perubahan hujan bermusim.

definition.en: Atmospheric conditions at a place over a short time.
definition.bm: Keadaan atmosfera di sesuatu tempat dalam tempoh yang singkat.

definition.en: Average weather of a place over a long period (about 30 years).
definition.bm: Purata cuaca sesuatu tempat dalam tempoh yang panjang (kira-kira 30 tahun).

definition.en: Seasonal wind that changes direction during the year.
definition.bm: Angin bermusim yang berubah arah dalam setahun.

definition.en: Rain from rising hot, moist air, often in the afternoon.
definition.bm: Hujan daripada udara panas dan lembap yang naik, selalunya pada waktu petang.

definition.en: Rain when moist air is forced up over mountains.
definition.bm: Hujan apabila udara lembap dipaksa naik melepasi gunung.

question.en: Why does the east coast of the Peninsula get heavy rain from November to March?
question.bm: Mengapakah pantai timur Semenanjung menerima hujan lebat dari November hingga Mac?

steps.en: The Northeast Monsoon blows from the north-east across the South China Sea.
steps.bm: Monsun Timur Laut bertiup dari timur laut merentasi Laut China Selatan.

steps.en: The winds pick up a lot of moisture over the sea.
steps.bm: Angin menyerap banyak wap air di atas laut.

steps.en: They meet the east coast first and are forced up over the Main Range, giving heavy rain.
steps.bm: Angin itu tiba di pantai timur dahulu dan dipaksa naik melepasi Banjaran Titiwangsa, menurunkan hujan lebat.

answer.en: Moist Northeast Monsoon winds + relief → heavy rain and floods.
answer.bm: Angin Monsun Timur Laut yang lembap + bentuk muka bumi → hujan lebat dan banjir.

prompt.en: Which instrument measures rainfall?
prompt.bm: Alat manakah mengukur hujan?

explanation.en: Rainfall is measured in millimetres.
explanation.bm: Hujan diukur dalam milimeter.

prompt.en: Which instrument measures air pressure?
prompt.bm: Alat manakah mengukur tekanan udara?

explanation.en: Pressure is measured in hectopascals or millibars.
explanation.bm: Tekanan diukur dalam hektopascal atau milibar.

prompt.en: An anemometer measures…
prompt.bm: Anemometer mengukur…

explanation.en: A wind vane shows wind direction.
explanation.bm: Ram-ram angin menunjukkan arah angin.

prompt.en: Thermometers at weather stations are kept in a white, louvred box called a ______ screen.
prompt.bm: Termometer di stesen cuaca disimpan dalam kotak putih berlubang dipanggil skrin ______.

explanation.en: It shades the thermometers so they measure air temperature accurately.
explanation.bm: Ia melindungi termometer daripada cahaya matahari supaya suhu udara diukur dengan tepat.

prompt.en: Malaysia's climate is described as…
prompt.bm: Iklim Malaysia digambarkan sebagai…

explanation.en: Malaysia lies close to the Equator.
explanation.bm: Malaysia terletak berhampiran Khatulistiwa.

options.en: equatorial — hot and wet all year
options.bm: khatulistiwa — panas dan lembap sepanjang tahun

prompt.en: The Northeast Monsoon blows in Malaysia from about…
prompt.bm: Monsun Timur Laut bertiup di Malaysia dari kira-kira…

explanation.en: It brings heavy rain to the east coast of the Peninsula.
explanation.bm: Ia membawa hujan lebat ke pantai timur Semenanjung.

prompt.en: Afternoon thunderstorms after a hot morning are usually…
prompt.bm: Ribut petir pada waktu petang selepas pagi yang panas biasanya…

explanation.en: Hot air rises, cools and condenses into rain clouds.
explanation.bm: Udara panas naik, menyejuk dan memeluwap menjadi awan hujan.

prompt.en: Weather differs from climate because weather is…
prompt.bm: Cuaca berbeza daripada iklim kerana cuaca ialah…

explanation.en: Climate is the long-term average.
explanation.bm: Iklim ialah purata jangka panjang.

prompt.en: Match each element with its instrument.
prompt.bm: Padankan unsur dengan alatnya.

explanation.en: Weather stations record all of these.
explanation.bm: Stesen cuaca merekod semua ini.

prompt.en: The Southwest Monsoon (about May–September) is usually a drier period for most of the Peninsula because…
prompt.bm: Monsun Barat Daya (kira-kira Mei–September) biasanya tempoh lebih kering bagi kebanyakan Semenanjung kerana…

explanation.en: The winds lose much moisture over Sumatra.
explanation.bm: Angin kehilangan banyak wap air di atas Sumatera.

options.en: Sumatra shelters the Peninsula from these winds
options.bm: Sumatera melindungi Semenanjung daripada angin ini

prompt.en: Relief rain falls mostly on the…
prompt.bm: Hujan bukit turun kebanyakannya di cerun…

explanation.en: The leeward side is drier — a rain shadow.
explanation.bm: Cerun lindung angin lebih kering — kawasan bayangan hujan.

prompt.en: Select ALL features of Malaysia's climate.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA ciri iklim Malaysia.

explanation.en: Malaysia does not get snow; highlands are only cooler.
explanation.bm: Malaysia tidak menerima salji; tanah tinggi hanya lebih sejuk.

prompt.en: The periods between the two monsoons are called the ______-monsoon periods.
prompt.bm: Tempoh antara dua monsun dipanggil tempoh ______ monsun.

explanation.en: Around April–May and October–November, with afternoon thunderstorms.
explanation.bm: Sekitar April–Mei dan Oktober–November, dengan ribut petir pada waktu petang.

prompt.en: Why are places like Cameron Highlands cooler than Kuala Lumpur?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah tempat seperti Cameron Highlands lebih sejuk daripada Kuala Lumpur?

explanation.en: Roughly 6 °C cooler for every 1 000 m of height.
explanation.bm: Kira-kira 6 °C lebih sejuk bagi setiap 1 000 m ketinggian.

prompt.en: Arrange the steps of convectional rain.
prompt.bm: Susun langkah hujan perolakan.

explanation.en: Common in the afternoon in Malaysia.
explanation.bm: Biasa berlaku pada waktu petang di Malaysia.

items.en: The sun heats the ground strongly
items.bm: Matahari memanaskan permukaan bumi dengan kuat

items.en: The air cools and water vapour condenses into clouds
items.bm: Udara menyejuk dan wap air memeluwap menjadi awan

items.en: Heavy rain falls, often with thunder
items.bm: Hujan lebat turun, selalunya dengan petir

prompt.en: Which statement about humidity in Malaysia is TRUE?
prompt.bm: Pernyataan manakah BENAR tentang kelembapan di Malaysia?

explanation.en: Hot air holds a lot of moisture from the seas and forests.
explanation.bm: Udara panas membawa banyak wap air dari laut dan hutan.

options.en: It is high, often around 80% or more
options.bm: Ia tinggi, selalunya sekitar 80% atau lebih

options.en: It is measured with a rain gauge

prompt.en: A family plans a beach holiday in Terengganu. Which month is the RISKIEST, and why?
prompt.bm: Sebuah keluarga merancang percutian pantai di Terengganu. Bulan manakah PALING berisiko, dan mengapa?

explanation.en: Many east-coast islands close during the monsoon.
explanation.bm: Banyak pulau di pantai timur ditutup semasa monsun.

options.en: December — Northeast Monsoon brings rough seas, heavy rain and floods
options.bm: Disember — Monsun Timur Laut membawa laut bergelora, hujan lebat dan banjir

prompt.en: Why is the Stevenson screen painted white and raised above the ground?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah skrin Stevenson dicat putih dan dinaikkan dari tanah?

explanation.en: Louvres let air flow freely.
explanation.bm: Bilah-bilah membolehkan udara mengalir bebas.

options.en: White reflects sunlight and height avoids heat from the ground, giving accurate air temperature
options.bm: Putih memantulkan cahaya matahari dan ketinggian mengelakkan haba dari tanah, memberi suhu udara yang tepat

prompt.en: Why do floods on the east coast of the Peninsula often happen in November–January?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah banjir di pantai timur Semenanjung sering berlaku pada November–Januari?

explanation.en: High tides can also slow rivers draining into the sea.
explanation.bm: Air pasang besar juga boleh melambatkan aliran sungai ke laut.

options.en: Heavy Northeast Monsoon rain over days fills rivers beyond their capacity
options.bm: Hujan lebat Monsun Timur Laut selama beberapa hari memenuhi sungai melebihi kapasiti

prompt.en: Climate change may make heavy rain events more intense. Which action BEST reduces flood risk for a town?
prompt.bm: Perubahan iklim mungkin menjadikan hujan lebat lebih kuat. Tindakan manakah PALING mengurangkan risiko banjir bagi sebuah bandar?

explanation.en: Forests and wetlands absorb water and slow run-off.
explanation.bm: Hutan dan tanah lembap menyerap air dan melambatkan air larian.

options.en: Keep drains clear, protect forests and wetlands, and avoid building on floodplains
options.bm: Pastikan longkang bersih, lindungi hutan dan tanah lembap, dan elak membina di dataran banjir
